211
Called Meeting of the City Council
Austin Texas October 31, 1882
W A Daylor Mayor Presiding
Roll call present Aldermen Schubin Bruggerhoff Radkey Moeller Platt & Wilson absent Cook
Kuepperitz A fine of one dollar was entered against Alderman Cook Kuepperitz & Kinney for
non attendance at this meeting.
Call of the Council was read which
was for the purpose of taking into consideration matters pertaining to the City Elections
Reading of the minutes of Oct 25th 1882 postponed until next meeting.
To Hon W A Daylor mayor of Austin
Sir we the undersigned Aldermen respectfully request that you call a Special meeting of
the City Council for the purpose of reconsidering the resolution ordering an Election of
the City Marshal and sub mitting the school Tax question on the 7th day of Nov.
1882 H. W Moeller W B Metz W Wilson H B Kinney Alderman Bruggerhoff presented a petition
from Citizens of Austin protesting against postponing the City Elections that was ordered
November 7 1882 On motion of alderman Bruggerhoff the petition was received and ordered
filed Alderman Bruggerhoff moved that the Council take no action in regard to postponing
the City Elections Motion adopted by the following vote yeas Aldermen Schubin Bruggerhoff
Platt Wilson Shep Radkey and Moeller. absent Aldermen Cook Kuepperitz.

The mayor nominated Henry Brown and
Henry Bannbruche as special Police officers The nominations were confirmed by acclamation
On motion of alderman Bruggerhoff the
Council adjourned
Read and approved Nov 20 1882
[illegible]

L Purnell
City Clerk
